objective.text: Characterize the behavior of weak coflow diffusion flames of methane and ethylene, as a function of velocity and fuel dilution, through measurement of flame shape, lift-off heights, temperatures and extinction limits.

fuel.text: The investigation studies methane and ethylene diffusion flames over a wide range of test conditions.
